blocks.text: THE AGE OF DARKNESS AND BRIGHTNESS— “We are entering the year 1995, and as the Scripts have already predicted it will be a year of surprises and the unexpected concerning every facet and direction of society and with nature and weather travailing! World crises before the end of it will begin to come into focus!” — I foresee man submerging deeper towards hell and the lake of fire! “At the same time I foresee the children of God getting in line preparing for the Translation and heaven!” Some events in religion will almost deceive the very elect; but can not. And the favored elect will be shown deep and wonderful revelations from the Lord accompanied by a powerful anointing to rest upon them! “Just before Jesus appears something similar to the book of Acts in 2:4 will take place, yet in a more awesome and wonderful way!” — The glory lights and clouds will surround them with a sealing to keep them until His appearing! — While the wise will receive more miracles and wisdom from the Lord Jesus, mankind will receive knowledge for more inventions and knowledge in technology. Tremendous changes in new things, and science will make new discoveries never known before! — “It will be a year of judgment across the land and violence, and a year of grace to those who are expecting and seeking more from our Saviour!

THE MARK CASTING ITS SHADOW BEFORE— “Foreboding and ominous signs are beginning to appear that was predicted by the Scripts for this decade!” — New type systems in money and identifications are appearing now and in the next year or so! For instance the micro chip, (The News report says) is no bigger than a grain of rice and it can contain all of the information about the person that they need! And in the future they have a microchip that can be used in the same manner that sends out signals that can locate the person no matter where they go or try to hide! “In the hands of a dictator it means absolute control of those who are left behind on the earth! — Also new things are coming in the banking system! I predicted in the 70's that they would have a card that would instantly take money from people's accounts, on the spot electrically. This has already come to pass! It is called the debit card. According to news reports they are going to mail one just to about everybody who is joined to these banks and they can do business with 10 million merchants worldwide! By computerized system, a person can do business anywhere on the earth without writing checks by just using their personalized number that is given to them! — Many newer changes and alterations are on their way that will blend into International trade. (Rev. chap. 18) — A word of warning! “All will lead to a mark in the skin finally, known as the mark of the beast! It will be digital meaning the name, the number and the mark will all represent the same thing, etc.”

SHADOWS OF HEALTH, LIFE OR DEATH— I have received scores of letters asking me if the President’s health program will be the mark of the beast by forcing everyone to be part of it. —“Probably not at first, but socialized type medicine finally will come and wind up in the mark as many other type things will also! Like buying, selling, credit and etc.” Sinister things are being prepared on the drawing boards of men that will be released at the proper moment! All kinds of news reports are being released and I’ll quote one. — “For the first time in history Americans are going to be required to carry an electronic identification card. The Clinton medical plan requires Americans to carry a card at all times with a magnetic strip that identifies them and contains an enormous amount of other information. The most devastating blow to the liberty of Americans is about to be struck by a federal government that wants to be equal to God. Americans are about to lose a major part of their freedom. The “Medical Security Card” Hillary Clinton has designed has a magnetic strip on the back of it. That strip will contain your social security number; your driver’s license number; your place of work and what your salary is; the location of your home; the names and addresses of your children and all your medical records.” — This is what one Christian report is informing people of. They also believed before the year 2000 that it would be part of the mark system! Like I said before, at first whenever this plan goes into action it will probably look harmless; but later lead into a snare when a world dictator uses it in the wrong manner! (By then over the whole earth.) — “With what I have foreseen the digital code is not too far off. The things that at first look good, peace and etc. will later turn into death!” (Rev. chap 6) As the white horse of deception turns into the chilling apocalyptic pale horse of death! — We are writing this to all our partners to watch and to pray! — “Before it becomes the mark, I believe God’s children escape into the Translation!”

PROPHETIC CLOCK STRIKING MIDNIGHT— We are living in the zero hour of some of the beginning of Daniel’s last prophecies! — In a message here I said that terrorist would try to prevent the long awaited covenant. But in this century there will be an agreement! Probably not too far off! Now here is a news quote: — “Vatican prepares for Palestinian relations (ROME) — The Vatican is getting ready to establish official relations with Palestinians, Pope John Paul II said Saturday. The announcement was welcomed by Palestinians leaders in the new self-rule religions. The Vatican is keenly interested in improving relations with Mideast players so it can be involved in peace efforts, especially any decision that might shape the future of Jerusalem or affect the lives of Roman Catholics in the region. The Holy See has established diplomatic relations with Israel and Jordan in recent months. — “When they are finished the Prince that shall come will add and confirm this agreement with Israel and many nations!” — Suddenly in the middle of the 90's on we will see a flood of events concerning the future! — (Note: As this was being written a great solar eclipse took place, Nov. 3, ’94. And just before it Jordan signed a treaty with Israel. President Clinton attended the ceremony!) — Also there was other celestial signs! — “This is an important visionary Script.”

THE GENERATION OF GENERATIONS— A multitude of things have and will take place before this one ends! “Like Israel’s Jubilee. The inch lines on the Great Pyramid. Plus the crossing cycles, numerical signs and symbols of the Scriptures!” — Here is a good prophetic viewpoint.” — Right after the beginning of this century in the early 1900’s the great outpouring of Pentecost took place! And in this same century before it ends another great outpouring has and is taking place; and should finish before the ending of the century!” — Plus just after the outpouring the great 1906 San Francisco earthquake took place! And in the coming next few years the greatest quakes of our century will take place! And finally beyond this in dimension the axis change will tilt and level the cities of the nations! — “We must remember the 1946-47 outpouring of gifts came just as Israel became a nation revealing we have entered the last generation!” — And may I add to this in celestial prophecy, Luke 21:25, Jesus said, “he would shew forth wonders in the heaven!” — Here is some information, at the ending of 1994 an important heavenly body will move into a fiery constellation! Then in January 1995, a heavenly body that does not move for many years will move into the same constellation! This one takes 244 years to circle the 12 constellations, so it is a vital entering and sign! And then again in ’95 another slow moving heavenly body enters another constellation, and it has not been there for 84 years! — “So according to what the Scripts have said and according to the stirring above, you can expect some spectacular events, surprises and some drastic unexpected changes in the few short years ahead!” Let’s expect Jesus anytime now and in the near future. Amen! “The key words here are be vigilant, lookup, watch and pray!”

FULL OF DEADLY POISON— The roadblocks appearing! — The Balaam doctrine is even now mixing up with the Pentecostal systems. This will produce more Laodiceans because when they go into the system directly or indirectly, we might say they are mixing hot and cold together! This will produce lukewarmness and God will spew them out of His mouth! And the Nicoloutanes (Rey. 2:6, 14-15) underneath are beginning to control everything working with the Babylon system (Rev. 17) — Also the Jezebel doctrine (Rev. 2:20-21) is alive and well today seducing some of God’ churches into false doctrine! — “The handwriting is on the wall! The space to repent for them is running out.” — All of this becomes part of Rev. 17:1-5 — “This prophecy is fulfilling to the letter and the cup of iniquity is running over!” — And because some of the Full Gospel churches and Pentecostals well known T.V. ministers are involved it will almost deceive the very elect, but can't. “God holds them in His hand! Remember many are called, but few are chosen!”
